summary: Completed comprehensive testing of AI-powered banner image generation feature. All backend APIs (7/7 tests passed) and frontend UI elements working correctly. AI generation uses OpenAI GPT Image 1 via emergentintegrations library with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.
critical_code_review_comments: AI Banner Generation implementation is complete and working correctly
POST /api/banners/generate-ai returns image_url and image_base64 (takes 30-60 seconds)
BannerManagement modal has two tabs: Upload Image (data-testid='banner-tab-upload') and AI Generate (data-testid='banner-tab-ai')
AI Generate tab shows prompt textarea (data-testid='ai-banner-prompt'), style dropdown (data-testid='ai-banner-style'), and Generate button (data-testid='ai-banner-generate-btn')
Style options: Modern & Clean, Bold & Vibrant, Minimal & Elegant, Luxury & Premium
Generated AI images can be used to create banners via POST /api/banners/
Homepage hero carousel displays admin banners with data-testid='hero-admin-banner'
Banner click tracking works via POST /api/banners/{id}/track-click
Upload endpoint POST /api/banners/upload still works for manual uploads
seed_data_creation: Test banners created during pytest execution (prefixed with TEST_) are cleaned up automatically. AI-generated banner files exist in /app/frontend/public/banners/
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Banner Generation feature is fully implemented and tested. Multiple AI-generated banner files exist in /app/frontend/public/banners/ai_banner_*.png. The BannerManagement component has imageMode state to switch between 'upload' and 'ai' modes.
